title: 第15章 你是来挖祖坟的吧第16章 白虎牌
content_zh:
余烬闻声望去，只见一位身穿布衣的老人，满头白发苍苍，倚靠在溪流边的一棵大树下歇息，在老人前面，还有一个年纪约莫在十一二岁的小少年。
那小少年穿着一件单薄的白衣，样子虎头虎脑，坐在一块光滑的石墩上，手里拿着一杆鱼竿正在岸边垂钓，他斜了一眼余烬之后，便似乎失去了兴趣一般，索然无味地收回目光。
余烬看了眼老黄狗，后者不知道为何呜咽着不敢抬头，似乎遇见了什么害怕的东西。
他想了想，走了过去，“老人家，你们在这钓鱼呢？”
老人在树下打着盹，听见余烬的声音，懒洋洋地抬起眼皮，“你瞎啊？没看见在钓着呢！？”
余烬：……
“可这里是余氏族山，你们不怕被那些老怪物发现？”余烬在老人旁边坐下，笑了笑，“或者说，你也是余氏的老怪物之一？”
“你看我像余氏的人？”老人瞬间翻脸，“他余氏祖宗十八代积满德，也生不出老子这么英武的种啊！”
余烬看着老人满头凌乱飘散的白发，上面还有着一根枯草，说话时有一颗漏风的门牙，脚下那双草鞋还有一只破了个洞，露出的脚指头很不安分地动了一下，也就那一身麻衣还勉强算干净。
还没等余烬开口，老人忽然打了个喷嚏，随手擦了擦鼻子之后，便抹在了衣服上。
“老人家确实英武不凡。”余烬深以为然地点点头。
老人笑眯眯道：“撒谎成性，是不是你们余氏的传统？老的这样，大的这样，小的也这样？”
余烬脸色平静，“我可不是余氏的人。”
老人忽然直勾勾地盯着余烬，好半响后，轻咦了一声，“你好像还真不是，不对不对……你个小娃娃长得好生奇怪！”
老人坐直腰杆，脸上那副懒懒散散的模样消失不见，取而代之的是一种说不清的疑惑。
就连余烬也是摸不着头脑，远处一直不敢靠近的老黄狗，突然朝着这边低唤了一声。
余烬看了眼黄皮老狗，问那老人，“老人家有什么问题吗？”
“罢了罢了，反正又不干我屁事，”老人摆了摆手，忽然恼怒地脱下一只草鞋，摔在了那钓鱼的小少年后脑勺上，“你钓了大半天，好了没有，一条鱼也没钓着，你想饿死你师尊是不是？”
小少年被砸了一下，眼神一沉，死死地盯着前面的溪水，那瞬间就像是一只饿虎要择人而食，可他最终却什么也没有说，又继续盯着手里的鱼竿。
“哟你还生气了，想欺师灭祖不成？量你也不敢！”老人呸了一声，转头乐呵呵地看向余烬，“这是我刚收的不肖弟子，脾气不好资质也一般，说实话我看你挺顺眼的，要不你也磕个头拜个师？”

余烬愣一下，这也太随意了，“我还有事要做。”
老人眼睛一亮，忽然压低声音说道：“你往东边走，翻过一块半人高的石头，见到一棵被雷劈过的歪脖子树就左转，走个半盏茶的功夫，你要找的东西就在那！”
余烬一脸茫然，“什么东西？”
老人贼兮兮地看了眼周围，“余氏第十三代家主的衣冠冢！你不是要来刨他们家祖坟的吗？！”
余烬眨了眨眼睛。
小少年微微撇头看了这边一眼，又若无其事地收回目光。
老人一脸失落地说道：“你私闯余氏禁地族山，又不是余氏的人，不刨祖坟，你来做什么？”
余烬苦笑了一下，“我是对余氏不满，但要针对也是针对他们的人，至于老人家的想法……挺特别。”
“针对他们的人？这个好！”老人脸上的失落转为笑容，朝着小少年的背影努努嘴，“诺，那个，余氏的，揍他！”
余烬微微愣了一下，转头看向那件若无其事的小白衣，“余氏的小辈，怎么会出现在族山上？”
余氏的族山乃是禁地，即使是议事殿的长辈也没有资格进来，更别说是一个十一二岁的少年。
老人开口催促道：“你管他这么多做什么，揍他就是了，往死里揍！”
余烬微微摇头，“虽然我不知道你们为什么会在这里，但既然你不是余氏的老怪物那就算了，我就不打扰你们了，告辞。”
“哦，既然你不愿意出手，那我就让他出手好了。”老人一脸贱兮兮地笑道：“余昆仑，别钓鱼了，老子命令你揍他！”
content_en:
When Yu Yan heard the sound, he saw an old man in cloth clothes with white hair resting against a big tree by the stream. In front of the old man, there was a young boy about eleven or twelve years old.
The young boy was wearing a thin white coat and looked tiger-like. He was sitting on a smooth stone pier and was fishing on the shore with a fishing rod in his hand. After he glanced sideways at the embers, he seemed to have lost interest and looked back indifferently.
Yi Yan glanced at the old yellow dog, who was whimpering and not daring to raise his head for some reason, as if he had encountered something he was afraid of.
He thought for a while and walked over, "Old man, are you fishing here?"
The old man was napping under the tree. Hearing the sound of embers, he lazily raised his eyelids and said, "Are you blind? Didn't you see that you were fishing!?"
Ember:…
"But this is the Yu Clan Mountain. Aren't you afraid of being discovered by those old monsters?" Yu Yan sat down next to the old man and smiled, "Or are you also one of the Yu Clan's old monsters?"
"Do you think I look like a member of the Yu family?" The old man suddenly turned his face. "His ancestors of the Yu family have been full of virtue for eighteen generations, but they couldn't produce a son as heroic as me!"
Yu Yan looked at the old man's messy white hair, with a piece of dead grass on it, and a leaky front tooth when he spoke. There was a hole in one of the straw sandals under his feet, and his exposed toes moved restlessly, so the linen clothes were still barely clean.
Before Yan Yan could speak, the old man suddenly sneezed, wiped his nose casually, and then wiped it on his clothes.
"The old man is indeed very heroic." Yi Yan nodded with deep understanding.
The old man smiled and said: "Lying is a habit of yours, isn't it the tradition of your Yu family? The old ones are like this, the older ones are like this, and the younger ones are like this too?"
Yi Yan's face was calm, "I'm not from the Yu family."
The old man suddenly stared straight at the embers. After a while, he let out a light sigh, "You really don't seem to be that, right? You look so weird, little baby!"
The old man sat upright, the lazy look on his face disappeared, replaced by an indescribable confusion.
Even Yi Yan was confused. The old yellow dog that had been afraid to approach from a distance suddenly barked in this direction.
Yi Yan glanced at the yellow-skinned old dog and asked the old man, "Is there any problem, old man?"
"That's all, it's not my business anyway," the old man waved his hand, and suddenly took off one of his straw sandals angrily and threw it on the back of the fishing boy's head, "You've been fishing for most of the day. Are you okay? You didn't catch a single fish. Do you want your master to starve to death?"
The little boy was hit, his eyes darkened, and he stared at the stream in front of him. At that moment, he was like a hungry tiger trying to choose people to eat, but in the end he said nothing and continued to stare at the fishing rod in his hand.
"Hey, you're still angry. Do you want to deceive your master and destroy your ancestors? You wouldn't even dare to do it!" The old man snorted and turned to look at Yu Yan cheerfully. "This is the unscrupulous disciple I just accepted. He has a bad temper and average qualifications. To be honest, I think you are quite pleasing to me. Why don't you kowtow and become a master?"
Yi Yan was stunned for a moment, this was too casual, "I still have things to do."
The old man's eyes lit up, and he suddenly lowered his voice and said: "Go east, climb over a stone half a man's height, and turn left when you see a crooked tree struck by lightning. It will take half a cup of tea to walk, and the thing you are looking for is right there!"
Ember looked confused, "What?"
The old man looked around with a sly look, "The tomb of the thirteenth generation head of the Yu family! Aren't you here to dig up their ancestral grave?!"
Ember blinked.
The young boy turned his head slightly and glanced here, then looked away as if nothing had happened.
The old man said with a disappointed look on his face: "You trespassed into the forbidden area of the Yu family's clan mountain. You are not a member of the Yu family. If you don't dig up the ancestral graves, what are you doing here?"
Ember smiled bitterly, "IHe is dissatisfied with the Yu family, but he wants to target people who are also targeting them. As for the old man's thoughts...it's quite special. "
“Aimed at their people? This is good! The disappointment on the old man's face turned into a smile, and he nuzzled at the young boy's back, "Nuo, that one, Yu's, beat him!" "
Yi Yan was stunned for a moment, then turned to look at the young man in white clothes as if nothing had happened, "How come a junior from the Yu family appears on Clan Mountain? "
The Yu family's clan mountain is a forbidden area, and even the elders of the meeting hall are not qualified to enter, let alone an eleven or twelve year old boy.
The old man urged: "You don't care what he does, just beat him, beat him to death! "
Yi Yan shook his head slightly, "Although I don't know why you are here, but since you are not the old monster of the Yu family, forget it, I won't disturb you, and take my leave. "
"Oh, since you are unwilling to take action, then I will let him take action. The old man said with a mean smile: "Yu Kunlun, stop fishing, I order you to beat him!" "
